newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kookmin Bank sets HK$1 bln FRN.
newsitem.headline: Kookmin Bank sets HK$1 bln FRN.

text.p: Kookmin Bank's HK$1 billion floating rate note has been closed, joint lead manager Sakura Finance Asia said on Tuesday.
The three-year facility was priced at par to float at 40 basis points over the six-month Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
The fee is 30 basis points split as 15 basis points for management underwriting and 15 basis points for selling concession.
Joint lead managers are Merrill Lynch Far East and Sakura Finance Asia.
Senior co-lead managers are Asahi Finance, BNP, JP Morgan, Dresdner and Royal Bank of Scotland.
Co-lead mangers are NatWest Markets, Nippon Credit International and Nord/LB.
Co-managers are Hang Seng Bank, China Construction Bank, Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, Jardine Fleming Bank and Tokyo-Mitsubishi Int'l.
Payment date is Oct 29, 1996, and the deal is now free to trade.
